file_insights.changes_summary: Refactored order_list view to use apply_list_filters utility instead of manual filter implementation
key_modifications: Replaced individual filter parameter extraction with FilterConfig objects
Replaced manual queryset filtering logic with apply_list_filters utility call
Replaced manual pagination with pagination handled by apply_list_filters
Updated context data to use result dictionary from apply_list_filters
file_insights.complexity_reduction: Reduced manual filtering/pagination logic from ~20 lines to 1 utility call with configuration

patterns_discovered.description: Manual filtering logic replaced with declarative FilterConfig objects passed to a utility function
patterns_discovered.implementation: FilterConfig objects define param_name, filter_type, and filter-specific kwargs
patterns_discovered.benefit: Centralized filter handling, reduced code duplication, improved maintainability

patterns_discovered.description: Filter behavior defined through configuration rather than imperative code
patterns_discovered.flexibility: Allows different filter types (search across multiple fields, exact field matching)

patterns_discovered.description: Combined pagination and filtering into a single utility function (apply_list_filters)
patterns_discovered.responsibilities: Handles parameter extraction, filter application, pagination, and result formatting

gotchas_discovered.description: Code now depends on apply_list_filters returning specific dictionary keys: 'queryset' and 'filter_values'
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Utility function contract must be well-documented and stable

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Loss of explicit filtering code visibility
gotchas_discovered.description: Filter logic is now abstracted away in utility function - harder to debug individual filter behavior
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Utility function should provide clear debugging output or logging

gotchas_discovered.description: Previous code ordered by '-order_date', '-created_at' tuple. New code only specifies '-order_date' as default_ordering
gotchas_discovered.impact: Secondary sort by created_at is lost unless apply_list_filters handles multiple orderings

approach_outcome.description: Successfully refactored order_list view to use apply_list_filters utility
code_quality_improvements: Reduced code duplication by using utility function
Improved maintainability through declarative filter configuration
Separated concerns between filter definition and application logic
approach_outcome.implementation_notes: Replaced 20+ lines of manual filtering and pagination with 6 FilterConfig objects and 1 utility call

recommendations.rationale: Original code used tuple ordering '-order_date', '-created_at'. New code only specifies '-order_date'. Verify this doesn't change sort behavior
Code depends on specific keys in result dictionary ('queryset', 'filter_values'). Document the contract clearly
This pattern is reusable across other list views in the application - identify similar candidates for refactoring

recommendations.recommendation: Add test coverage for search field combinations
recommendations.rationale: Search filter now searches across 3 fields (reference_number, supplier__trade_name, supplier__legal_name). Ensure Q object logic is preserved
Abstraction layer added - verify pagination and filtering performance remains acceptable
